privacy-policy.title: 🔒 Privacy Policy
content: Your privacy is paramount. This policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and respect your personal information.

The PHELONPRENEUR Network ("Company," "we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains in detail how information is collected, used, stored, disclosed, and safeguarded when you access our website, schedule consultations, or engage with our services.
We are clear about what information we collect and how we use it. No hidden practices.
We never sell, lease, trade, or monetize your personal information. Period.
We implement robust security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access.
You have rights over your data. You can access, correct, or request deletion at any time.
We collect information in two primary categories:
Information you voluntarily provide such as name, email address, and written responses through contact forms, scheduling forms, or intake questionnaires.
Non-identifying information such as browser type, device information, IP address, pages visited, and timestamps for analytics and security.
Government identification numbers (unless you voluntarily provide them)
Information collected is used strictly for the following purposes:
To respond to your inquiries and provide requested information
To provide readiness-related support and strategic guidance
To schedule and manage consultations and appointments
To enhance functionality, user experience, and content
To maintain internal records and operational documentation
To ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations
Sell, lease, trade, rent, or otherwise monetize your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.
While we treat all information with the utmost discretion and care, it is important to understand the legal limitations:
Communications through this website or our services are
No attorney-client, therapist-client, or other protected professional relationship is created
Information shared may not be protected from legal disclosure in the same way as communications with licensed professionals
We handle all information with care but cannot guarantee absolute confidentiality in all circumstances
If you require legally privileged communication, please consult with a licensed attorney. Our services do not provide the same legal protections as attorney-client privilege.
We take your privacy seriously and limit disclosure of your information. However, we may disclose information in the following circumstances:
When required by law, court order, subpoena, or governmental regulation
When necessary to protect the rights, safety, or property of the Company, our users, or others
With trusted third-party service providers who assist with website operations, scheduling systems, or analytics (under strict confidentiality obligations)
In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets (with continued protection of your information)
When you explicitly authorize us to share your information

Email service providers, scheduling platforms (e.g., Calendly), website hosting services, and analytics tools. These providers are contractually obligated to protect your data and use it only for specified purposes.
We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
SSL/TLS encryption for data transmitted over the internet
Limited access to personal information on a need-to-know basis
Protected servers and databases with industry-standard security protocols
Ongoing security assessments and software updates
Staff education on privacy and data protection best practices

While we take every reasonable precaution to protect your information, no system can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. By using our website and services, you acknowledge this inherent risk when providing information online. We encourage you to use strong passwords and practice good security hygiene.
We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to analyze website traffic, remember your preferences, and improve your user experience.
Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites remember information about your visit. They enable essential functionality and help us understand how visitors use our site.
Required for website functionality and security
Help us understand site usage and improve performance
You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality. For more information, please see our
Our website may contain links to third-party websites, services, or resources for your convenience and information. These might include:

We are not responsible for the content, privacy practices, security measures, or terms of service of third-party websites. When you click on external links, you leave our website and are subject to the policies of those third parties. We strongly encourage you to review the privacy policies and terms of any external websites you visit.
You have important rights regarding your personal information. Depending on your location and applicable laws, these may include:
Request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information.
Request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal limitations.
Unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time.
Request your data in a portable, machine-readable format.
Request limitation of how we process your personal information.
To make a request regarding your personal information, please contact us through the method provided on our
. We will respond to your request within a reasonable timeframe, subject to legal and operational limitations.

Please note that certain rights may be limited by applicable laws or operational requirements (e.g., we may need to retain certain information for legal compliance or to complete transactions you've requested).
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect:
Changes in our business practices or services
Feedback from users and privacy advocates

When we make changes, we will update the "Effective Date" at the top of this policy. For significant changes that materially affect your rights or how we use your information, we may provide additional notice through:
A prominent notice on our website
Email notification (if we have your email address)

Continued use of our website or services after any updates to this Privacy Policy constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy. We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, we want to hear from you.
Please use the contact methods listed on our
to reach out with any privacy-related inquiries.
We are committed to addressing your concerns promptly and transparently. Your privacy and trust are important to us.
We're committed to protecting your information while providing the support you need. If you're ready to take the next step with confidence, we're here to help.
Your information is safe with us. Let's begin your journey together.

cookie-policy.title: 🍪 Cookie Policy
content: Understanding how we use cookies to enhance your experience while respecting your privacy.

This Cookie Policy explains how The PHELONPRENEUR Network ("we," "our," or "us") uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website. We believe in transparency and want you to understand exactly how these small files help improve your experience.

Cookies are small text files placed on your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you visit a website. Think of them as your website's memory—they help the site remember your preferences, keep you logged in, and understand how you interact with different pages.
Cookies do not give us access to your device or personal information beyond what you choose to share with us. They're purely functional tools designed to enhance your browsing experience.
We take a minimalist, privacy-first approach to cookies. Here's exactly what we do:
Ensuring the website works properly and securely
Understanding how visitors use our site to improve it
Protecting against malicious activity and fraud
We do not use cookies for advertising, remarketing, behavioral profiling, or selling your data. Your privacy is our priority.
We categorize our cookies into the following types:
Required for the website to function. These enable core features like security, network management, and accessibility.
Help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting aggregated, anonymized data.
Remember your preferences and choices to provide enhanced, personalized features.
All cookies are used responsibly and in compliance with applicable privacy laws. We regularly review and minimize our cookie usage.
Some third-party services we use for scheduling, analytics, or other functionality may place their own cookies on your device. Examples include:
We do not control these third-party cookies. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party services to understand their cookie practices.
You have full control over cookies. Here's how to manage them in popular browsers:
Disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality and your user experience. Essential cookies cannot be disabled without breaking core features.
Delete cookies when you close your browser
Where required by law, we will present a cookie consent banner when you first visit our website. You can accept or decline non-essential cookies through this banner.
By accepting cookies or continuing to use the website after being informed of our cookie usage, you consent to this Cookie Policy and our use of cookies as described.
You can withdraw your consent at any time by adjusting your cookie preferences in your browser settings or through our cookie management tool (if available).
We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices, technologies, legal requirements, or for other operational reasons.
When we make significant changes, we will update the "Effective Date" at the top of this policy. We encourage you to review this policy regularly.
Continued use of the website after any updates constitutes your acceptance of the revised Cookie Policy.
If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy, how we use cookies, or wish to exercise your rights regarding cookies, please don't hesitate to reach out.
You can contact us through the methods listed on our
Your privacy matters to us. If you're comfortable with our cookie usage and ready to begin your transformation journey, we're here to help.

thanks.title: Your program request has been received.
thanks.label: Service request received
intro: Thank you for choosing The PHELONPRENEUR Network. Your program or service request has been received, and our team is preparing the next step in your onboarding process.

Required next step: please complete your intake form before we review your case. The intake form helps us understand your situation, organize your information, and review your needs properly. A link to complete the form will be sent to the email address you provided after this message.
thanks.stepsLede: Your onboarding is not complete until the intake form is submitted. Once your form is received, our team can review your information and determine the appropriate next steps for your program or service.
steps: You will receive an email with the intake form link and any important next-step instructions. If you do not see it, please check your spam, junk, or promotions folder.
Please answer the form as completely and accurately as possible. This is required so our team can properly review your case, needs, and service direction.
After your intake form is submitted, our team will review the information provided and prepare the next steps connected to the program or service you selected.
If we need clarification, missing details, or supporting documents, our team will contact you using the information you submitted.
notes: This form helps us review your case properly

It helps us understand your current situation, goals, and areas of concern. It allows our team to review the correct information before taking action. It helps prevent delays caused by missing details or incomplete information. It gives us a clear starting point so we can better support your selected service.
Do not skip the intake form
Your program or service cannot be reviewed properly until the intake form is completed. Please submit it as soon as possible so our team can begin reviewing your information.
The form link will be sent to your email

Your next step is to complete the intake form.

Once we receive your completed intake form, our team will have the information needed to review your case and move forward with your program or service. Please check your email for the form link and complete it carefully.
